html:
A guitarist and singer from Niafunke on the Niger in northern Mali, who became one of the best-known African musicians in the world.

He played Songhai, Fula and Tamasheq songs on guitar in a style that listeners abroad compared to the American blues, and it was called desert blues. His album Talking Timbuktu (1994) with Ry Cooder won a Grammy, and he won another in 2006 with the kora player Toumani Diabate. He stayed a farmer and was mayor of Niafunke. His success opened the way for later Malian bands such as the Tuareg group Tinariwen. See also Timbuktu and Songhai.
sum: A guitarist and singer from Niafunke on the Niger in northern Mali, who became one of the best-known African musicians in the world.
